policy.status: Accepted planning design; production qualification and assumed demand response unproven
policy.demand_basis: Combined product-attractiveness and incremental campaign intent uplift applied once to Artemis only before package-price elasticity. New buyers, not an extra redistribution of the existing pool; not measured conversion. No independent marketing bonus. 60% Mono Pro mix is an explicit common scenario assumption.
policy.crt_status: M36-141W period candidate; 640×400 qualification and purchase prices are assumptions, not supplier assurances.

interpretation: Central Artemis interest increases 12% before elasticity, but higher prices can offset it. ROI uses expanded capacity for all modeled demand plus 10% reserve; sales page retains its constrained delivery forecast. PRO sales start conditionally in 1981 and add no 1980 revenue. ROI sensitivity controls vary marketing cost only; they do not re-estimate sales.
